items.label: Roughly, in a normal month: the past 12 months average 24.2% with February removed. It counts the client's language, not nationality

footnote: Source: Valve, Steam Hardware & Software Survey. Average calculated, one dot is about 1%
notes: How many Chinese-language users are on Steam? Valve's own survey says that in a normal month about a quarter run the Simplified Chinese client, and a little over a third run English. Two traps. First, this is the client language in a voluntary survey, not nationality. Second, every February it jumps to around half and falls back the next month, so never read a single month as a trend. I used the twelve months from October 2025 to September 2026, February removed: 24.2% on average. What it means for us: one store sells to both home and abroad, but most of its users are not on the Chinese client.
